title: A solo owner session gets its own merge role, and only it may use it
why: The merge role file has no form for a solo session that the owner started (follow-up of step merge-role-allow).
note: Pick taken by the coordinator, no page item (16:32 CST Nov 7): option C. The session-start hook writes merge role 'solo-owner' into the role file only when the session has no parent and no cs-build tag. read_merge_role accepts it only when the session id in the file equals the calling session's own id.
